cli.finalMessage:
Added a two-factor authentication section to the security settings page.

**`src/screens/Screen.tsx`** — a security settings page with:
- An On/Off switch (`role="switch"`) for 2FA.
- A method choice (radio group: Authenticator app vs. Text message), shown only when enabled, with a masked phone number hint for SMS.
- A backup codes panel with show/hide, regenerate, and copy actions, plus a used/remaining indicator.
- Turning 2FA **off** opens a confirmation dialog ("This makes your account less secure...") with Cancel/Turn off actions, focus trapping, Escape-to-cancel, and focus restoration. Turning it **on** applies immediately, no confirmation needed.
- A visually-hidden `aria-live` region announces state changes for screen readers.

**`src/screens/Screen.module.css`** — styled entirely with Strata design tokens (`var(--strata-*, fallback)`) and logical CSS properties, so it adapts across brands, light/dark, density, and RTL locales automatically, with safe fallback values in case a token name differs.

Mock data (backup codes, phone number) lives directly in `Screen.tsx`. I didn't touch `main.tsx`, `app.css`, `package.json`, or config files, and since `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` aren't installed in this environment (no `node_modules`), I built the UI with plain semantic HTML/ARIA rather than guessing at unverifiable component APIs, to keep it type-safe and buildable.
